versions.content: For an Eep module driving an external EEPROM through SPI: In fast EEPROM mode, the Eep module shall access the external EEPROM by usage of SPI channels that are configured for burst access to the SPI EEPROM.

snippets.why: Fast EEPROM mode SPI burst access
